risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or produce sound
risks.proof: A video clip showing the unit plugged in, powering on, and playing a note through the speakers

risks.risk: Some keys may be stuck, broken, or unresponsive
risks.proof: A video sweeping across all keys showing each one depressing and sounding correctly
risks.if_unproven: priced as partially functional at best

risks.risk: Display screen and control buttons may not work
risks.proof: A video showing the display lighting up and menu/button navigation working
risks.if_unproven: priced as if display/controls are non-functional

risks.risk: No power adapter, stand, or box included, raising cost to actually use it
risks.proof: A photo of the adapter/cord and stand being included with the sale
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit with no accessories

risks.risk: Hidden damage (cracks, water damage, broken ports) on back or underside
risks.proof: Clear photos of the rear panel, underside, and any ports/battery compartment
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, worst case

risks.risk: Exact model/series unclear (two different Yamaha labels visible), affecting true market value
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model/serial number plate, usually on the back or underside
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower end of generic Yamaha home keyboards

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on and playing several notes across the keyboard range
Video sweeping all keys to confirm none are stuck or silent
Clear photo of the model/serial number plate
Photos of the back and underside of the unit
Confirmation and photo of included power adapter/stand, if any
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used Yamaha home keyboard, but functionality, completeness, and exact model are unproven, so it must be priced at worst case (non-functional, no accessories) until the listed proofs are provided.
